gold_mentioned_in_reasoning: gold action id found in raw reasoning text (reasoning_content or <think> block); for models with no reasoning channel it falls back to raw content; gold_mention_channel records which

override_mechanism.how: dataclasses.replace(resolved_dialect, max_tokens=cap) passed to LocalSLMBackend(dialect=...), with ToolDecisionRequest(max_tokens=cap) so min(request, dialect) == cap
override_mechanism.why_needed: dialect_for(tool_parser, tool_call_template) matches tool_parser first; nemotron/hammer rows resolve to HERMES_DIALECT (256) and functiongemma to FUNCTIONGEMMA_DIALECT (128), so the requested 1024 never reached the wire
override_mechanism.wire_verification: WireTransport._post records the literal payload['max_tokens']; stored per receipt as wire_max_tokens / effective_max_tokens; invalid_cell flags any mismatch

post_run.note_tool_call_emitted: raw.jsonl's tool_call_emitted uses dialect-pattern detection only and undercounts Hammer's single-quoted repr array; report.json/md derive tool_call_emitted from structured signatures instead.

reasoning_tokens_method: exact count of reasoning_text under the resident llama-server's own /tokenize endpoint (child port 18100-18159); falls back to chars/4 and records reasoning_token_method per call

schedule_design.order: rep-major; models rotated by rep; within a model block, states rotated by rep and the caps of each state rotated by (rep+state_index); one warmup call per model block (recorded with kind=warmup, excluded from analysis)
schedule_design.purpose: interleave + time-rotate caps so a warm/cold or time-of-day artifact cannot masquerade as a cap effect

settings.arm: compiler+<model> (compiler-first, identical to Phase 1B core arms)
settings.temperature: dialect default (0.0 for all six dialects)
settings.top_p: server default (not sent by the adapter)
